description: One knob driving up to four mapped parameters and two CV outputs, each with its own scaling and slew.

params.text: Binds one parameter: press it, then click a knob, fader or switch on any module.
Sets the value sent to every mapped parameter and to both CV outputs, 0% to 100%, through the scaling set for each of them.

inputs.text: Sets the macro value by voltage in place of the knob, which then attenuates it; 0-10V, or -5V to 5V on the menu.

outputs.text: Carries the macro value as a voltage, through the scaling set for that output on its context menu.

notes: nothing is controlled until a mapping button is pressed and a knob, fader or switch on another module is clicked.
menu: Slew-limiting, Low and High — on a mapping button's own right-click menu: Slew-limiting smooths what reaches that parameter, and Low and High scale the range it covers.
Output voltage, Slew-limiting, Low and High — on a CV output port's own right-click menu, setting that output to 0V..10V or -5V..5V, its slew, and the range it covers.
Precision — Audio rate, High, Moderate or Lowest, updating the mapped parameters at the sample rate or at an eighth, a sixty-fourth or a two hundred and fifty-sixth of it.
Lock parameter changes — switched off, a mapped parameter can be moved by hand for as long as the macro value stays where it is.
Input voltage — reads the IN port as 0V..10V or as -5V..5V.
